headline: Retirement applications, disability cases, and cost-of-living adjustments are on the agenda, along with consultant and request-for-proposal items.
summary: Financial items include expense warrants, bank reconciliations, and a trial balance. Other topics include PERAC memos, Consultant-Mariner, and refunds and transfers.
items: Trial balance and statement of financial activities
location: Room 207, 20 Korean Veterans Plaza, Holyoke, MA
plain_text:
Pursuant to G.L. c. 30A, § 20(b) notice is hereby given that a meeting of a Holyoke Retirement
Board Meeting to be held at 20 Korean Veterans Plaza, Room 207, Holyoke, MA. (Previously
scheduled for September 24, 2026)
Board Meeting: Thursday, October 1, 2026 @ 9:00 A.M.
Agenda Topics:
Meeting Minutes July 30, 2026 and August 27, 2026
Expense Warrant Approval
Bank Reconciliations
Trial Balance and Statement of Financial Activities
Retirement Applications
Disabilities
PERAC Memos
Consultant-Mariner
RFP'S
COLA
Appropriations
Manager Reviews
Refunds and Transfers
